searchText: Is `pip install 'idna<3'` in the ddht virtualenv going to cause any problems? I had 3.1 installed by default somehow. <@!425615769280315392> should probably note the branch in the `launch-trin.sh` script too. Did you try it with 3.1? I imagine it was just a "we don't know what will be backwards-incompatible at the next major version" restriction, rather than a "something is definitely wrong at >=3" restriction. It just died complaining about the version. Seemed to work fine with 2.10 though. `trin` works on master for me, does it not for you? Wasn't anywhere to apply the bootnode patch I could have an old master though 🤔 Ah yeah, there are a number of recent merges into master kk In fact if you refresh the launch script gist, you'll see that the patch is no longer necessary because you can set the bootnodes at the command line Fancy!
